scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp widget-output-cache.php dist/ && cp -R languages dist/languages && sed -e 's/^# \(.*\)$/=== \1 ===/' -e 's/^## \(.*\)$/== \1 ==/' -e 's/^### \(.*\)$/= \1 =/' -e '/^<!-- changelog -->$/d' readme.md > dist/readme.txt
scripts.zip: npm run build && npx wp-release zip dist --slug widget-output-cache --force
